answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 23536 Country: India Title: Are there any Supplications/ dua's to practice during pregnency for a husband and wife for a nek aur swaleha male child? Question: Are there any Supplications/ dua's to practice during pregnency for a husband and wife for a nek aur swaleha male child? Answer ID: 23536 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1208/980/B=1431) Husband and wife should recite the following ayah during pregnancy as much as they can: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً [الفرقان : 74] Besides, both should follow the commandments of Shariah completely and should not take any step against the Shariah. In-sha-Allah, they will be blessed with pious children. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
